name: E2Gold Inc.
summary: E2Gold Inc. is a Canadian enterprise dedicated to the acquisition, exploration, assessment, and advancement of mineral resources across the country. The company's main focus is prospecting for gold, alongside a variety of precious metals and other metallic and non-metallic elements. Its most significant undertaking is the Hawkins Gold Property, an expansive area covering 544 square kilometers with 2,553 claims, located in north-central Ontario, Canada. Founded in 2018, the company was initially known as 5003754 Ontario Inc. until it adopted the name E2Gold Inc. in February 2020. E2Gold Inc. is based in Toronto, Canada.
